title: GOOSE GHOSTS
oneLiner: Hunt the fleeing ghosts as a goose, alone or together.
mechanics: Buffered four-direction tile movement with continuous pixel interpolation and paired side tunnels.
A goose permanently hunts the ghosts; touching them captures them and never kills the goose.
Four fleeing ghosts leave a visible central house through its ghost-only door, return as eyes after capture, reform, and leave again.
Collect pellets for points and power pickups for a speed/score boost.
Honk with A to briefly stun nearby fleeing ghosts; the honk recharges.
Catch eight ghosts within sixty seconds to clear the first round; the next rounds require two more captures, up to three rounds.
In 2P both players control separate geese and share progress, time and score.
artDirection: Original 19×19 maze drawn with connected cyan-blue wall outlines and dark corridors. Central enclosed ghost house and pink door are distinct. Directional original goose and ghost pixel clips are 14×14, center anchored, with white feathers, colored P1/P2 wings, orange beaks and feet. Returning ghosts are eyes only until they visibly reform at home.

preserve: central ghost house and visible exits
change: the goose is permanently the hunter
ghosts flee and are captured on contact

lose: Time expires before the capture target; ghost contact does not harm the goose.
scoring: 10 per pellet, 50 per power pickup, 200 per capture (400 while powered), and 500×round completion bonus; both players share credit.
note: Original maze and pixel artwork inspired by the maze-chase genre.
